acceptance: A list of each gh call made from a cell, with its purpose.
After the fix, the I5 shadow log of one wave shows no read of ~/.config/gh/.
No cell has the GitHub token in its environment unless the operator approved it.
fix: Find which cell steps call gh (router, build, audit) and why. Either remove gh from cells (the pipeline does the GitHub work outside the cell) or pass a scoped token through the manifest env allowlist; never a read of hosts.yml. Operator decides which before I5 enforce.

intake_override.reason: Console route: security and the I5 isolation stage.

notes: Console route: security and the I5 isolation stage.
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator "investigate in watcher issue"; wave-145 errors channel 10:05Z-12:40Z (1387 WARN signals)
summary: In wave 145 the I5 shadow log recorded 360 reads outside grants; the top ones are ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml and ~/.config/gh/config.yml by the router, build and audit cells (rule read.home.secret). hosts.yml holds the GitHub token. At I5 enforce these reads are denied and every gh call in a cell fails.
title: Decide and enforce how a phase cell reaches GitHub without reading ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml
